name: Eonia Transbaal
original_name: エオニア・トランスバール
source: Eonia was exiled to outer space for wanting to use lost technology to conquer other planets and expand the Transbaal Empire. He returned with a large, mysterious fleet, and used it to murder the royal family (except Prince Shiva) and lead a coup against Transbaal.
